# Fortify Wagon Laager
oe_war2_ua_fortify_wagon_laager = {
	duration = -1
	toggle = yes
	army_only = yes
	cancel_on_combat_end = no
	cancel_on_move = yes
	map = yes

	hidden = {
		owner ?= { is_rebel_country = yes }
	}

	allow = {
		is_army = yes
		has_only_prisoners = no
		is_moving = no
		is_exiled = no
		in_retreat = no

	modifier = {
		discipline = 0.06
		land_morale_recovery = 0.18
		land_unit_attrition = -0.20
		army_movement_speed = -0.35
	}

	start_effect = {
	}

	finished_when = {
		OR = {
			is_moving = yes
			is_exiled = yes
			in_retreat = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1
	}

	ai_will_revoke = {
		value = 1
	}
}

# Volley Fire Drill
oe_war2_ua_volley_fire_drill = {
	duration = -1
	toggle = yes
	army_only = yes
	cancel_on_combat_end = no
	map = yes

	hidden = {
		NOT = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery } }
	}

	allow = {
		is_army = yes
		has_only_prisoners = no
		is_exiled = no
		in_retreat = no
		OR = {
			any_sub_unit = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_light_infantry }
			any_sub_unit = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_heavy_infantry }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		army_light_infantry_power = 0.14
		army_heavy_infantry_power = 0.10
		discipline = 0.04
		army_maintenance_efficiency = -0.22
		army_movement_speed = -0.10
	}

	start_effect = {
	}

	finished_when = {
		OR = {
			is_exiled = yes
			in_retreat = yes
			NOR = {
				any_sub_unit = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_light_infantry }
				any_sub_unit = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_heavy_infantry }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1
	}

	ai_will_revoke = {
		value = 1
	}
}

	modifier = {

		navy_movement_speed = 0.15
		blockade_efficiency = 0.18

	}

	finished_when = {
		OR = {
			is_exiled = yes
			in_retreat = yes
			NOR = {
				any_sub_unit = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:navy_light_ship }

			}

# Imperial Forced March
oe_war2_ua_imperial_forced_march = {
	duration = -1
	toggle = yes
	army_only = yes

		combat_speed_modifier = 0.10

			has_commander = no
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1
	}

	ai_will_revoke = {
